title: Minecraftial Soup
description: The mod is for those who want to enhance their copy of Minecraft: Java Edition, which adds things such as new tools, food, and more!
body:
This mod enhances Minecraft: Java Edition to add the following:

New tools (Such as The full Emerald Toolset)
New Blocks (Such As New Brick varients for graanite, andesite
New Foodstuffs (Such as Carrot Soup)
New Paintings (Such as "The Brine")
Just some stuff to add a bit more vanilla-feeling fluff to your game.

Made for Neoforge in MCreator 5.2
